# testlib

This directory vendors `testlib.h` from MikeMirzayanov/testlib so runtime
images can compile C++ checkers, validators, generators, and interactors that
use `#include "testlib.h"`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/MikeMirzayanov/testlib
- Source commit: `1e4e8a24c79c6bad3becbdb5a332ffc352b7d5dd`
- Header version: `0.9.45`
- License notice: retained in `testlib.h`
